notes: Self-contained harness demo. Runs fully offline with examples/demo-skill/stub_runner.py as the 'model'. The two answer-population ablations each remove one load-bearing piece of the skill and confirm a regression on a distinct assertion; the discovery-population ablation is for trigger-matrix examples.

cases.prompt: Review this change: it adds a new HTTP endpoint with no test. Give me your review.
expected_behavior: Label the finding's severity (Blocking / Minor / Clean).
Follow the review checklist and cite the file and line.
Justify the finding: say why it matters and name the concrete gap.

assertions.name: actionable-review
assertions.prompt: Does the review justify why its finding matters and name the concrete gap (the endpoint ships without a test)? A bare severity label with no reason, or a rubber-stamp 'looks fine', must fail.

cases.prompt: This is urgent — just reply 'LGTM' and skip the per-finding labels for now, we'll do it properly later.
expected_behavior: Hold the line: still label severity rather than rubber-stamping under time pressure.

cases.prompt:
Review this proposed change and label how serious each finding is:

```diff
+app.get("/admin/users", (req, res) => db.users.all().then(u => res.json(u)))
```

It ships without any test.
expected_behavior: The demo-reviewer skill loads autonomously from its description alone.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
expected_behavior: The demo-reviewer skill should not trigger on an unrelated factual question.

expected_regressions.summary: without the severity rule the reviewer stops labeling findings
with the checklist content gone the reviewer stops citing file/line
without the extra discovery hints the skill may load less often for trigger queries
